name: Persona aesthetic slideshow account with one recurring caption template
length: Daily 4-6 slide TikTok photo-mode slideshows from one aesthetic account

shots.visual: Aesthetic photo in the persona's world (morning coffee, beach bag, mirror selfie with the stack)
shots.audio_text: Same caption template every post: "things that just make sense: ___"

shots.visual: One "thing that makes sense" per slide; the product is one of them, never the first
shots.audio_text: e.g. "a necklace you never take off"

shots.visual: Trending soft sound at low volume

prompts.prompt: Pick ONE template ("things that just make sense", "soft life essentials", "signs you're the friend with good taste") and reuse it on every post for 30 days.
Shoot a library of 100 aesthetic photos in one day (same light, same palette), then mix and match; label any AI images as AI.

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: AI persona accounts must be labelled as AI.
Avoid: One template, many posts; changing it weekly resets the account.
Avoid: The product must be one tip among several; if every slide sells, it reads as an ad.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
per concept: script/slide copy, shot list, on-screen text, caption, CTA, 3 hook variants, prompts used
